title: 03  电脑版剪映音频剪辑.mp4
origin: User-provided local Jianying tutorial; abstracted principles, not a bundled preset.

route_semantics.typed: Supported technique.2.0 fields; build and validate an explicit graph.
route_semantics.recipe: Executable builder producing a typed graph.
route_semantics.workflow: Existing main workflow; separate confirmation and evidence remain required.
route_semantics.external: Not bundled; exact resource/voice/preset needs explicit licensed input.
route_semantics.knowledge: Planning abstraction only; no new automatic detector or segmentation implementation.

techniques.name: Non-destructive audio intervals and independent tracks
techniques.intent: Keep music editing reversible and represent overlapping audio explicitly.

operations: decode supported audio and reject unsupported/encrypted formats without renaming extensions
copy references rather than destructively cut source
sum active audio tracks after per-track gain/envelope
code_expression.timing: At timeline t, source sample time is source_in+(t-timeline_start)*speed.

pitfalls: Overlapping tracks increase summed level and may clip.
Importing a music library or URL does not establish redistribution rights.
The old requirement to add video before audio is historical UI behavior, not a mathematical pipeline requirement.
validation: Restoring trim metadata exposes original content.
Check mixed peaks and audition intended cues.

techniques.name: Fade-in and fade-out as time-domain gain envelopes
techniques.intent: Avoid abrupt music start/end by ramping gain over configured intervals.

operations: choose fade intervals on the final clip duration
compute envelope from elapsed time and remaining time
multiply source samples by gain envelope

curve.default_for_code: linear only if chosen; tutorial exact proprietary curve unknown

code_expression.timing: u=t-timeline_start; a_in=clamp(u/fade_in,0,1), a_out=clamp((duration-u)/fade_out,0,1); use a chosen envelope policy for overlap.

pitfalls: 7.1 s is a demonstration value, not a default for every edit.
Applying to all clips can override deliberately different gains.
Exact Jianying fade curve is not proven from a waveform screenshot.
validation: Envelope reaches silence at intended boundaries.
Audition actual render for clicks, pacing and audible fade lengths; this review did not audition.

techniques.name: Separate audio speed, pitch policy and beat markers
techniques.intent: Retiming and timing guides should stay explicit and independently adjustable.

operations: derive speed=source_duration/target_duration when duration is specified
use time-stretch when pitch should remain stable
use resampling when pitch should follow speed
store detected/manual markers in source-relative seconds
map source markers to timeline after trim/speed

pitfalls: Resampling and pitch-preserving time stretch have different audible results.
Do not copy rounded UI duration as exact source timing.
Beat detection is a suggestion and does not establish which visual cut is appropriate.
Historical library-only beat restriction should not be imposed on a modern local detector.
validation: Verify duration mathematically and decoded sample count.
Check marker movement after speed or trim changes.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified and has homophone/shortcut errors.
Exact time-stretch algorithm, fade interpolation and current application UI capabilities are not established.
Original library asset rights and availability are unknown.
